title: Bhogapuram airport: government promises to settle farmers’ compensation through court
description: Minister Kondapalli Srinivas and Collector S. Ramsundar Reddy told farmers’ families the money deposited with the Visakhapatnam tribunal would reach them in a few months; farmers who gave land for the approach road had sought up to ₹1 crore an acre against the ₹48 lakh offered
